💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hushpuppy: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Lockpick: Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Cliffhanger: Go for the eyes. When it lunges, strike the EYES or the soft palate inside the mouth — the armored hide shrugs off everything else. Never fight it in the water; that's its studio. On land, get beside it: it turns like a bus. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Paparazzo: Break line of sight before the fourth shot. Four shots is the whole fight — break line of sight before the fourth and the model starves. The EXCLUSIVE cannot be dodged, only prevented: move while the lens steadies. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Static: Don't walk toward the voice. Resist the lure: don't move toward the crying. Two rounds of refusal and the act breaks — it's a radio, exposed and furious, and it has to re-spool before it rushes. That's your window. (You did the thing — and it worked.)
💡 Turkish is starting to make sense. You catch the shape of sentences now.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Understudy: Hit it with something it's never seen. It copies what it sees — strike with a weapon it has NEVER seen and the copy falls apart. The familiar is what kills you. Switch weapons mid-fight and it's back to guessing. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Static Kite: Leave the marked square. The mark is generous — two full beats to leave the square. When it dips to transmit it's at melee height and takes +50%: that's the only window. Leave the square, then punish the dip. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — ducks in a row: Break the line. The line is one animal, but only while it's whole. Strike a duck that ISN'T the head and the line splits — both halves hunt on their own and the formation dies. Break the line, then thin the pieces. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Flashbulb Moth: Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Mountain Lord: Stand tall and shout. When it crouches to pounce, STAND TALL and SHOUT — bang metal, wave your arms, be loud and enormous. It expects prey to flee. Be the thing that doesn't, and the pounce dies unlaunched. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Inspiration: Be three tiles out. The bloom is the timer: two beats of brightening, then white. Be three tiles out when it flares. The ember beat after is safe — walk in and finish it while it glows itself out. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — mosquito: Hit it after it drinks. It only drinks adjacent — keep your distance during the dive. After it drinks it's HEAVY and SLOW: that's when you hit it. Smoke and fire ruin its whole plan. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nevermore: Step OFF the strafing lane. The shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides — a straight black lane. Step OFF it, not along it: it can't turn mid-run. It always lands after a run, hit or miss. Punish the landing. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
